name: knob-slider

frames.best_why: The dial is fully lit with a sharp 42 and its tick ring clear, with no cursor over the face.

tagline: Round dial ringed with ticks that spins and blurs its number as you drag.
summary: A circular knob edged with fine tick marks. Dragging around the ring turns a small triangle pointer and snaps the value to the nearest tick, while the big number rolls and blurs as it spins, then sharpens when it stops.
appearance: A large near-black circle on a black stage, ringed by dozens of short radial ticks. Inside sits a slightly lighter disc holding a very large white number, with a small grey triangle on the outer edge marking the current angle.
behaviour: Pressing the dial jumps the value to that angle, then dragging sweeps the triangle around and snaps to one of seventy-two positions. While the pointer moves, the number blurs and rolls like a slot machine and clears as it settles.
demo_content: The value 42 with the caption "Volume, drag around the dial".
search_phrases: turn a dial to pick a number
drag around a circle to set value
spin a knob to choose a level
round volume knob for a web app
use_when: A single value should be set with a tactile rotary feel, such as volume or intensity.
avoid_when: It is mouse-only, with no wheel or keyboard input, and takes a large fixed square of space.
customise: Value, change handler, minimum, maximum and diameter are props; the tick count, digit spring and blur rule are fixed in the file.
weight_why: One SVG tick ring and spring-animated digits that idle when the dial is not dragged.

a11y.note: The dial has no slider role, aria-valuenow, keyboard control or focus ring, so it works only with a mouse.

issues: No keyboard or screen-reader support: it is a div with no slider role or value.
A single click sets the value, so a stray click changes the setting.
polish_why: Crisp tick ring and a convincing slot-number blur; mouse-only use and missing semantics cost it.
title: Knob Slider
